sentences.en: We all abide by law to live in any society.
sentences.zh: 我们在任何社会都要遵守法律。

sentences.en: The law will be effective from the 1st of April.
sentences.zh: 从4月1日起，这项法律将生效。

sentences.en: The law kept people from playing football for a while.
sentences.zh: 法律规定了一段时间内不能踢足球。
